scope: Typed immutable join and private native support-export coordinator for an original acquisition case and explicitly selected retained verification collection. No new product command, public worker/frontend admission or stable ABI.
join: Reconstruct the original AcquisitionCase from exact raw request/history. Require full canonical case/revision equality with the selected case and the collection original_case, and exact retained request/history byte equality with the collection. Reject foreign cases, changed raw whitespace/history and contradictory revisions. Neither construction nor restore follows paths in retained content or changes original acquisition claims. Require at least one retained verification observation; an empty collection does not establish historical_verification=recorded.
report: AcquisitionVerificationReport is immutable. Its full private view contains schema, acquisition {revision,view}, verification {revision,view}, and fixed claims. Its revision hashes that complete canonical view. Acquisition before/after and later verification observations remain separate. historical_verification=recorded means retained observations exist, not a matched verdict, authenticated actor/custody, current image or process exit. The private full view retains the existing collection string bound (1 MiB) for raw history hex; support (8 KiB strings) and public request bounds are unchanged.
support: Create a new acquisition-verification-support-prototype/1 projection with scope recorded-acquisition-verification, explicit four-boolean policy, acquisition.support(policy), verification.support(policy), and fixed claims. Preserve existing collection support unchanged. Exact typed constructors are the only artifact admission; scope recorded-acquisition-verification-support cannot enter the old acquisition-only export contract. Paths enter acquisition support only when identifiers, raw_values and customer_data are all true; never export private wrapper/source bindings, full raw request/history, context/record/observation/resource digests or replacement pseudonyms. interpretations remains labelled inference.
definition: The private acquisition-verification-export-definition-prototype/1 binds report/case/collection revisions and canonical case operation/collection IDs, sources {case,collection}, and the complete typed output effect. Validate exact source profiles, finite ordinary single-link metadata, bounded canonical integers and hashes, ancestry generations, and cross-source file identities. Construct only when original raw request/history hashes/sizes, case/store generation and retained collection artifact bytes/hash/revision exactly bind the typed report. Native reconstruction compares every reviewed field before execution; a digest is no approval or authenticated origin.
native: Use existing FileAcquisitionCase, explicitly selected FileImageVerificationCollection and FileReportExport. Read only selected fixed acquisition metadata and selected collection path; do not reopen retained source/image/map paths. Hold strong parent/file pins, use read sharing only and check original bytes/metadata/paths before and after reads. Serialize source checks under one owning coordinator. Reject output aliases by native Windows ordinal path comparison and fixed case children, preserve identity checks and create-new. Preparation creates no output; one owning session attempts execution once.
grants: Exact joint wrapper definition_digest plus case_read, collection_read, report_write and host_effects true. Reject any missing/false flag, wrong/inner digest or missing source/effect port before observations/effects. These declarations do not authenticate or expand operator privileges. Private complete collection retention remains a separate artifact requiring its existing private_metadata grant.
observations: Each fresh check visits case then collection separately, recording state and monotonic check_sequence for each visited source. matched is a validated observation for that sequence, never simultaneous capture or persistent freshness. A later failure preserves the other source last observation. Bound the number of visits to 256. Refused admission proves no dispatched effect; an executor exception is unknown with uncertain output/unknown written count. Late changed/unavailable sources cannot erase actual completed/partial output, counters or receipt. No retry, overwrite, cleanup, force or inferred worker exit.
outcome: Private joint outcome has schema,status,diagnostic,source_checks,source_observations {case,collection},output (existing complete ExportOutcome),scope and fixed limits/authenticity claims. A completed joint result requires completed verified output and both final source observations matched; otherwise preserve failure/unknown/cancellation and actual output independently. Individual OS filesystem calls have no universal latency guarantee; private synchronous qualification is not bounded product service admission. Reject a contradictory executor completed claim unless exact submitted/written/read/verified artifact byte counts, known write acknowledgements, completed phase, created output, confirmed API flush, empty diagnostic and no uncertainty agree. Preserve the reported nested outcome but set joint status unknown with verification_case_output_claim; it cannot qualify completion.
qualification: Author expectations before evaluation. Generate acquisition and actual contained verification through native disked, independently reconstruct raw case/history/collection hashes, exact joined full view and all sixteen selected support bytes/hashes. Test original-case/raw-byte mismatch, edited view/revisions, scope confusion, cross-source/path aliases, integer/byte/visit bounds, fifteen false-grant combinations and wrong/inner digests with zero ports. Actually prepare/reconstruct/export, hold read pins, reject source recreation between review/execution, reject existing outputs, cancellation and injected post-create/write/flush/read failures. Preserve output byte counts/receipts on late synthetic source changes and distinguish synthetic executor replies from actual native effects. Observe actual owned process exit before fixture cleanup.
next_gate: Qualify strict public producer semantics, contained report worker, bounded caller/observer/render budgets and actual CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell before selecting combined support in the product. Full DE-W034, authenticated custody/current-image authority, all specified platforms/storage and owner/physical/elevation/customer/install/signing/publication gates remain open.
